From: Dmitriy Traytel <cl-isabelle-users@lists.cam.ac.uk>
Subject: [isabelle] New in the AFP: Greibach's Hardest Context-Free Language

Tobias Nipkow continues his context-free conquest and now he has formalized a hardest of them all.

Greibach's Hardest Context-Free Language

Formalization of Greibach’s hardest context-free language theorem: There is a “hardest” context-free language L_0 such that every context-free language is an inverse homomorphic image of L_0.

https://isa-afp.org/entries/Greibach_Hardest.html

Enjoy!
